title: A complete logical export and import carries a whole store across a durable format change
outcome: A complete logical export and import carries a whole store across a durable format change
acceptance: A deliberately truncated export fails the comparison, so success cannot come from skipping data or disabling validation
A real export of the current store imports into an empty new store, and a comparison manifest matches every category, relation and content check with no unexplained difference
After import, ordinary resume, history reads and doctor all pass on the new store without repair
An export with an injected integrity fault is refused by the import and leaves no partially installed store
Claims, leases and session or execution state are preserved as data, and resume after a controlled offline cutover on the same host is safe, while no second host receives live authority
Original canonical bytes and their original hashes are retained, and every reference whose identity changed resolves through an explicit total mapping recorded in the new store
The export of a complete store names every category it contains with exact counts, and refuses rather than silently omitting anything it cannot represent

completion.summary: Delivered complete lossless logical export/import across aggregate-root and delta-root formats with retained canonical originals, total identity mapping, explicit representation audits, exact-page historical attribution handling and fail-closed source consistency checks. Negative controls, focused tests, nine gates, paired review and independent historical data acceptance passed. Advisor completed fresh two-store offline migration and accepted installed data; this session independently resumed through the installed CLI and matched a preselected pre-freeze note byte-for-byte. Same-host continuity only; host MCP deadline remains separately routed.
